title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of Broc Shot Capsules on Skin Appearance and Comfort in Adults With Reactive, Blemish-Prone, or Hormonally Affected Skin
official: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of Broc Shot Capsules on Skin Appearance and Comfort in Adults With Reactive, Blemish-Prone, or Hormonally Affected Skin
summary:
This is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, fully decentralized (remote) clinical trial evaluating the effects of Broc Shot Capsules on skin appearance and comfort in adults with reactive, blemish-prone, or hormonally affected skin. Fifty participants aged 18-65 years will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either Broc Shot Capsules (active) or matched placebo capsules for 8 weeks.

Participants will take 2 capsules once daily and complete self-reported questionnaires and standardized self-captured skin photographs at Baseline, Week 4, and Week 8 via a secure online study platform. Expert dermatologist grading of photographs will be conducted remotely at each timepoint. The study is designed to substantiate consumer product claims related to visible skin improvement and participant-reported skin comfort, and is not intended to evaluate treatment of any clinical dermatological disease.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults aged 18 to 65 years (inclusive) at the time of consent.
* Self-reported skin concerns matching at least one of the following descriptions: I have red, itchy skin patches
* I have dry, flaky/scaley skin patches
* my skin has blemishes such as pimples, discoloured papules (small, tender bumps that are pink/red/purple/or darker than your natural skin tone) or pustules (a distinct white or yellow pus-filled center surrounded by a red base).
* Generally healthy adults who are willing and able to follow the study protocol for the full 8-week duration, including taking 2 capsules of the study product once daily for 8 consecutive weeks without skipping days, answering questionnaires at Baseline, Week 4, and Week 8, and following the photograph submission protocol at Baseline, Week 4, and Week 8.
* Willing to avoid initiating any new topical or oral skincare products, prescription medications targeting skin, or other dietary supplements specifically marketed for skin benefit during the study period.
* Participants currently using such products who have been using them consistently for at least 3 months prior to enrollment and are willing to continue unchanged throughout the study are eligible.
* Willing to maintain their current diet, lifestyle, sleep pattern, sun exposure habits, and skincare routine for the duration of the trial.
* Resides within the United States.
* Access to a smartphone or computer with internet connection and the ability to use the Citruslabs digital study platform.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known allergy, hypersensitivity, or intolerance to broccoli, horseradish, other cruciferous vegetables (Brassicaceae family), or any component of the study product or placebo capsule.
* Currently pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant during the study period.
* Currently taking prescription anticoagulant medications (e.g., warfarin, apixaban, rivaroxaban) due to the potential for product ingredients to interact with anticoagulant activity.
* History of a severe or unstable medical condition that, in the opinion of the study team, would prevent safe participation or adherence to the protocol, including active cancer treatment.
* Currently using any oral, topical, or biologic prescription medication specifically indicated for a diagnosed dermatological condition, unless the regimen has been stable for at least 3 months and no changes are planned during the study period.
* Planned dermatological procedures during the study period (e.g., chemical peels, laser treatments, microneedling, injectable cosmetic procedures) that could confound skin appearance assessments.
* Currently enrolled in another clinical or consumer research study, or plans to enroll in any such study during the 8-week study period.
